methods.unit: One selected source document per reviewed English jurisdiction; overlapping passage offsets merged
methods.stemming: NLTK English Snowball; no POS tagging or claimed lemmatisation
methods.tfidf: Stemmed unigrams, min_df=2; each jurisdiction has equal document weight
methods.lsa: Two-component truncated SVD; first component can reflect general vocabulary, not a causal axis
methods.lda: Bag-of-stem counts; k=2,3,4, 3-fold document-held-out perplexity; fixed corpus vocabulary (exploratory selection, not an independent validation set); 10-seed ARI sensitivity
methods.readability: Rule-based sentence splitting; CMU syllables with Pyphen fallback; Dale-Chall bundled easy-word list. Fog counts all >=3-syllable words without proper-noun/compound exceptions. Approximate formula scores, not literal schooling years.
methods.feature_counting: Express wording in each jurisdiction’s selected primary document only. Supporting or historical documents are displayed separately and cannot add contemporaneous features. No observed feature is not proof of legal absence. Selected versions vary in date; this is not a 2026 legal census.
methods.scope: Selected English clauses, not all 250 countries; current texts are not retroactively assigned to historical years
